langCode.description: Language of this message file (used for <html lang>).

extDescription.message: Local password manager: fills logins from your Keystead desktop app – no cloud, everything stays on this computer.

csNoMatches.message: No matching logins for this page.

csNoFields.message: No login form found on this page.

csNoField.message: Click into the field that should receive the password first.

csFillFailed.message: The login could not be filled.

csNotConnected.message: Keystead is not connected. Open the extension to set up the connection.

csInsecureWarning.message: Warning: this page is not encrypted (http).

csInsecureBlocked.message: Not filled: this page is not encrypted (http), but the login is stored for https.

csNeverDone.message: Keystead won't ask on this site again.

hostMissingText.message: The extension works together with the Keystead app on this computer. To set it up:

hostStep2.message: In Keystead: Settings → Browser integration → click “Connect” next to your browser.

hostStep3.message: Close this window and open it again.

appUnavailableText.message: Start Keystead on this computer, then try again.

appTimeoutText.message: Keystead is not responding right now. Check that the app is running and try again.

pairText.message: Connect the extension to your Keystead app once. You confirm the connection in the app – your data never leaves this computer.

pairWaitingText.message: Check that Keystead shows the same code and click “Connect” there.

pairSuccessText.message: The extension is now connected to Keystead.

pairDeniedText.message: The request was denied in Keystead or has expired.

pairErrorText.message: The connection to Keystead could not be established.

lockedText.message: Enter your master password to unlock Keystead.

wrongPassword.message: Wrong master password. Please try again.

noPageLoginsTitle.message: No logins for this page yet

noPageLoginsText.message: Save your login and Keystead will fill it in here automatically.

notWebPageText.message: Keystead fills logins on web pages (http/https). Use “Search” to find all entries.

insecurePage.message: Unencrypted page (http): logins are only filled if they are stored for http as well.

neverSaveActive.message: Save prompts are off for this site.

searchHint.message: Search by name, username or website.

noFocusedField.message: Click into the password field on the page first.

errorNoFields.message: No login form found on the page. Try reloading the page.

errorInsecure.message: Not filled: unencrypted page (http), but the login is stored for https.

errorNotFound.message: This login doesn't match the page.
